# Q3 2026 Sales Review

## Summary
Total revenue for Q3 2026 reached $4.82M, up 2% from $4.71M in Q2. EMEA was the strongest region, growing revenue 7% quarter over quarter after the launch of the partner program in July.

## Regional performance
- **EMEA:** revenue grew 7% to $1.96M. Growth was driven by three new channel partners in Germany and the Nordics.
- **North America:** revenue grew 3% to $1.71M. Enterprise renewals were on plan; new-logo bookings slowed in August.
- **APAC:** revenue declined 5% to $1.15M. The Singapore office lost two senior account executives in July.

## Risks
APAC pipeline coverage for Q4 is 2.1x, below the 3x target. North America discounting increased to an average of 18% in September.

## Actions
Hire two account executives in APAC before November. Review the North America discount approval policy.
